Name: Mountain House - Farmhouse Replacement
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]
Cozy, modern log cabin for the farmer. A farmhouse sprite replacement with seasonal variations.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k2rMWJc.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Tested on the standard vanilla farm (Maps/Farm and Maps/Farm_Mining) with built-in compatibility for [b]Zenith Farm[/b].[/center]
[center]
For other custom farm maps, you will need to replace these lines inside your content.json:

[code]  {
   "Action":"EditMap",
   "Target":"Maps/Farm_Zenith",
   "FromFile":"assets/FrontPatch0.tmx",
   "FromArea": { "X": 0, "Y": 0, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 }, 
   "ToArea": { "X": 39, "Y": 11, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 },
   "PatchMode":"Overlay",
   "When":{"FarmhouseUpgrade":0}
  },
  {
   "Action":"EditMap",
   "Target":"Maps/Farm_Zenith",
   "FromFile":"assets/FrontPatch1.tmx",
   "FromArea": { "X": 0, "Y": 0, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 }, 
   "ToArea": { "X": 39, "Y": 11, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 },
   "PatchMode":"Overlay",
   "When":{"FarmhouseUpgrade":1}
  },
  {
   "Action":"EditMap",
   "Target":"Maps/Farm_Zenith",
   "FromFile":"assets/FrontPatch2.tmx",
   "FromArea": { "X": 0, "Y": 0, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 }, 
   "ToArea": { "X": 39, "Y": 11, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 },
   "PatchMode":"Overlay",
   "When":{"FarmhouseUpgrade":2}
  },
  {
   "Action":"EditMap",
   "Target":"Maps/Farm_Zenith",
   "FromFile":"assets/FrontPatch3.tmx",
   "FromArea": { "X": 0, "Y": 0, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 }, 
   "ToArea": { "X": 39, "Y": 11, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 },
   "PatchMode":"Overlay",
   "When":{"FarmhouseUpgrade":3}
  },[/code]
Replace [b]Farm_Zenith[/b] with your custom farm map's file name, and then update the [b]"ToArea"[/b] X and Y values to match the correct coordinates on your map. (You can find these coordinates using [b]Tiled[/b] or by debugging them in-game).




If you are using custom maps, you need to adjust the coordinates so the house patches align correctly. For example, if you are using [b]Beautiful Vista Farm by glymr[/b], your coordinate replacement values will be [b]X: 76[/b] and [b]Y: 2[/b].

To apply this, locate the patch blocks inside your content.json and update the lines like this:

[code]  {
   "Action": "EditMap",
   "Target": "Maps/Beautiful_Vista_Farm",
   "FromFile": "assets/FrontPatch0.tmx",
   "FromArea": { "X": 0, "Y": 0, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 }, 
   "ToArea": { "X": 76, "Y": 2, "Width": 9, "Height": 9 },
   "PatchMode": "Overlay",
   "When": { "FarmhouseUpgrade": 0 }
  },[/code][i](Note: Remember to repeat this target and coordinate swap for the remaining FrontPatch1, FrontPatch2, and FrontPatch3 code blocks in your file).[/i]

Visual reference for the X and Y coordinate replacement:[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/q5Fc9m3.jpeg[/img][/center]
